tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search current, open job vacancies in the Cayman Islands (from the official WORC Jobs Portal and employer careers pages), newest first. All filters are optional. Each result links to its caymanjobfinder.com page, which links to the official advert to apply.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get the basic facts of one current job by its slug (from search_jobs): title, employer, pay as stated, location, dates and the job page link, which links to the official advert for full details and how to apply.

tools.name: list_employers
tools.description: List employers with current vacancies in the Cayman Islands, with their number of open jobs and a link to their jobs on caymanjobfinder.com.

tools.name: hiring_report_stats
tools.description: Headline figures from the published monthly Cayman Hiring Report (job adverts posted on the official WORC Jobs Portal that month: adverts, positions, employers, median advertised pay, most advertised sectors, best-paid sectors, advert length), exactly as published, with a link to the full report and
